reviewer: Codex /root/roadmap_review; separate audit pass, not independent human double screening
scope: Bounded audit of excluded records across all three screening shards.96 model/kinetics-related titles read manually;20 selected abstracts reviewed, plus10 explicit clinical/control abstracts. Not a second complete screen.
selection_method: A lexical inventory (kinetic|absorp|clearance|model|compartment|distribution) identified96 of732 excluded titles for human-readable inspection; the inventory selected material, never determined exclusion. Suspicious records were escalated to abstract reading. Ten clinical/control records were purposefully selected to check hidden PK/control-arm evidence.
decision_limits: Audit recommendations do not mutate original screening records. No full-text eligibility promotion. Upheld decisions mean consistent with inspected title/abstract and narrow LIT-001 scope, not proof that full articles contain no other result. All unreviewed exclusions remain outside this audit.

overrides.basis: Abstract fits SC aspart PK, including absorption time and clearance, during variable closed-loop dosing. Retain for model ancestry and parameter-identifiability context; never pool as lispro primary data.
overrides.next_action: Inspect full model/source lineage only if needed for the model-family map; molecule already excludes primary lispro eligibility.

overrides.basis: Abstract explicitly compares eight SC infusion PK model designs, including practical identifiability and out-of-sample prediction. Its selected two-SC/interstitial/plasma structure is important model-family context despite aspart-only data.
overrides.next_action: Read original model equations/structure for the breadth map; keep aspart source and clinical results separate from lispro.

overrides.basis: Abstract compares three SC glargine absorption models in T1D and selects a two-compartment formulation-dependent structure. Retain narrowly as related Schiavon model ancestry, not as lispro evidence.
overrides.next_action: Cross-link as related long-acting branch only; do not add glargine parameters to the lispro dossier.

overrides.basis: Abstract explicitly states the diffusion-dimensionality models were tested on published SC insulin lispro data, although the title emphasizes antibodies and long-acting injectables. Exclusion would erase a distinct diffusion-based model family.
overrides.next_action: Retrieve original full text; identify lispro source study, adult/T1D eligibility, concentration, dose, published equations and reconstructibility before primary/background classification.

overrides.basis: Abstract describes a35-year-old woman with delayed absorption of SC regular insulin who regained glycemic control on SC lispro. Preserve atypical-absorption phenotype context; the abstract has no measured lispro concentration series and cannot identify absorption versus clearance.
